tools.name: slither
tools.purpose: Static analysis framework for Solidity; 90+ detectors.

tools.name: aderyn
tools.purpose: Rust-based Solidity AST analyzer; fast, modern detectors.

tools.name: mythril
tools.purpose: Symbolic execution / EVM bytecode security analysis.

tools.name: halmos
tools.purpose: Bounded symbolic execution (Z3-backed) reusing the project's own Foundry tests as the spec — proves no assertion violation exists in that bound, rather than sampling random inputs like Echidna/forge fuzzing. Docs example uses python3.12; confirmed working on 3.11 too (this repo's CI Python version).

tools.name: foundry
tools.purpose: Forge fuzz + invariant testing, Anvil mainnet-fork PoC.

tools.name: promptfoo
tools.purpose: CLI prompt/agent/RAG red-team + eval; generates adversarial test suites.

tools.name: deepteam
tools.purpose: LLM/agent red-teaming framework: 40+ vulns, attack enhancements (jailbreak, prompt injection, PII, bias).

tools.name: base_rpc
tools.purpose: Query Base mainnet via public JSON-RPC: balance, nonce, gas, block. No key, no LLM.

tools.name: market_data
